correctness.rationale: Plancherel's radial integral has power r^(d+3), giving heat-inner product proportional to (t+s)^(−ν) and normalized overlap sech^ν((log t−log s)/2). The beta substitution u=e^x yields 2^ν|Γ(ν/2+iy)|²/Γ(ν); Poisson summation then has factor 1/h and all aliases strictly positive. By Euler's product the Gamma ratio is the Laplace transform at y² of a sum of independent exponentials with summable means, so Tonelli expresses the periodization as a positive mixture of wrapped Gaussians. In the Jacobi product the first angle factor strictly decreases from 0 to π, the others are nonincreasing, and the products converge to positive values; comparison thus gives strict decrease of each Gaussian periodization and of the mixture without differentiating under the expectation. The exact Toeplitz form and arbitrarily long one-sided Fejér packets prove sharpness even for indices j≥0. Multiplication of the Gram sequence by sech^δ convolves the symbol with a full-support positive normalized probability kernel; nonconstancy makes both improvements strict. Stirling gives one leading alias at 0 and two at π, the rest exponentially smaller, yielding A∼2^(ν+2)π^ν h⁻ν exp(−π²/h)/Γ(ν) and B∼2^ν Γ(ν/2)²/(h Γ(ν)). Their ratio and 1/(16π²) in d=2 check. Dense scale asymptotics are for fixed dimension.
